edit.description: Widen the provision-only signature streak to stage-tagged (provision/merge/gate) accounting per spec/loop.md — TickVerdict gains merge cherry-pick-conflict and gate-revert signatures alongside provisionFailures; superviseLoop's quarantine + consecutive-identical backstop key off stage-tagged signature, not provision alone.
Extend the §16 superviseLoop suite to cover merge- and gate-stage quarantine/backstop, sibling to the existing provision-only cases.

summary: Generalize the consecutive-identical-failure backstop and per-entry quarantine past provisioning to merge and gate stages

per.section: Repeated identical failures — quarantine, then abort

tests: a merge-stage cherry-pick-conflict is recorded on the verdict with a stage-tagged signature
a gate revert is recorded with a signature derived from gate name + failure output
per-entry quarantine crosses to a tagged merge or gate failure, not provision-only
three consecutive ticks with an identical stage-tagged signature abort at abortThreshold, for merge and gate same as provision today
a voluntary bail or park never joins the accounting
a tick recording no failure of a class clears that class's streak
existing provision-only §16 cases still pass unchanged
acceptance: superviseLoop aborts non-zero on 3 consecutive identical merge- or gate-stage signatures exactly as it already does for provisioning, with per-entry quarantine covering all three stages
notes: Resolves the parked 'Merge-stage failure backstop' architecture fork — spec/loop.md already ratified one mechanism, one abortThreshold. Reuse MAX_PROVISION_SIGNATURE's bound/trim idiom for the new signatures rather than duplicating it; rename if it now covers all three stages.

edit.description: Add `flume check`: parsePending the working tree's pending.json, fence-check every entry, exit EX_DATAERR (65) naming entry + offending paths on refusal, 0 clean.
Cover check's parse-refusal, fence-refusal, and clean-pass exit paths.

summary: Add `flume check` — validate working-tree pending.json (parse + fence arithmetic) without spending an agent
tests: a parsePending schema violation exits EX_DATAERR naming the entry
an entry declaring a path outside the consumer phase's fence exits EX_DATAERR naming entry + offending paths
a clean pending.json exits 0
check mutates no baton flag and invokes no agent
acceptance: flume check exits 65 naming entry/paths on a fence or parse violation, 0 on a clean pending.json, with no agent spawned
notes: Resolves the parked 'flume check' question — reuse builtinGates.ts's pendingGate fence arithmetic (declaredPaths/matchesAny/entryWriteScopeUnion), don't reimplement it. Resolve the consumer phase's fence the way .flume/chain.ts wires buildFence into pendingGate's targetFence.

edit.description: Add `flume friction [name]`: bare lists the declared channel's notes (filename, size, mtime); with name, prints that note's bytes verbatim. Undeclared Chain.friction refuses usage-shaped, exit 2.
Cover list, cat-by-name, undeclared-channel refusal, and declared-but-absent-dir empty-list cases.

summary: Add `flume friction [name]` read verb — list or cat the declared friction channel's notes, uninterpreted
tests: bare friction lists declared channel notes (filename, size, mtime)
friction <name> prints that note's bytes verbatim
undeclared Chain.friction refuses usage-shaped, exit 2, naming the missing declaration
a declared-but-absent friction dir lists empty, exits 0
acceptance: flume friction [name] lists/cats the declared channel per spec/cli.md, refusing usage-shaped when undeclared
notes: Resolves the parked 'Friction read verbs' question — spec/chain.md's Chain.friction section already moved to 'interpreting' (not 'reading') its content, licensing this read verb. Mirror src/cli.ts's existing job-status friction-dir resolution (~L519) rather than re-deriving it.

edit.description: Add `flume log [-n N] [--json]`: print the last N (default 10) tick verdicts oldest-first via readTickVerdicts; --json emits records verbatim as JSONL.
Cover default-N human form, --json passthrough, and the no-verdicts-file empty case.

summary: Add `flume log [-n N] [--json]` — print recent tick verdicts, human table or JSONL passthrough
tests: default prints the last 10 verdicts oldest-first as fixed-format lines
-n N overrides the count
--json emits the TickVerdict records verbatim as JSONL, one per line
no tick-verdicts.jsonl prints nothing and exits 0
log mutates no baton flag
acceptance: flume log [-n N] [--json] renders tick-verdicts.jsonl per spec/cli.md — human table by default, JSONL with --json
notes: Resolves the partially-addressed 'Verdict read-side in the CLI' question — spec/cli.md now fixes verb name, flags, and both output shapes. readTickVerdicts is already exported (src/index.ts); this is CLI wiring only, no engine surface change.
